item.description:
## 1.0.21
- Replaced the NHI mascot with a compact new pixel-art character. - Removed the mascot window's unused vertical space, enlarged the character slightly, and moved task bubbles below it.

## 1.0.20
- Removed NHI coordination events and counters from the Gmail menu-bar inbox; NHI work is now handled through the mascot and its dedicated task board.

## 1.0.19
- Added a draggable always-on-top NHI desktop mascot for configured MAP users, including rounded task bubbles and a complete incoming/outgoing task board. - Added per-task urgency and task creator display; local agents now choose priority from task context. - Added after-meeting NHI reminders using only the recipient's local Google Calendar, with both native and mascot notifications. - Added durable recipient-owned agent-chat bindings: a task now opens the recipient's own saved Codex conversation instead of the originator's chat. - Codex in VS Code now types and submits the full NHI briefing through macOS Accessibility instead of only copying it to the clipboard. - Added local NHI debug improvements and remembered mascot position.
